primary_horizon: three pre-specified calendar months per vintage
primary_return_convention: compound each firm's three monthly CRSP returns, then equally weight firms
internal_benchmark: not available from the frozen checkpoint; an equal-weighted available-universe common-support return is retained as a descriptive diagnostic only
placebo_estimand: embedding-only relative to 100 frozen matched-cardinality placebo portfolios
pooled_placebo_inference: four-vintage mean compared with matched placebo-draw means
critical_minerals_benchmark: not used because none was frozen before outcome access
factor_alpha: not primary because each vintage contains only three monthly observations
delisting_return_caveat: no separate delisting-return field exists in the cached return checkpoint
